bild.underrad: It only covers the roof. Sides stay open.

CaraShellRoof_US_OB_105_1.message:
You're right: a full wrap would seal your trailer or motorhome all the way around.
This only covers the roof — 21 by 10 feet. The sides stay open, just like before.
Rain runs off the silver-coated 210D oxford fabric instead of pooling on top.
$199 (was $249, save $50). Order your roof cover.
CaraShellRoof_US_OB_105_1.headline: Yes, it's sealed. Just the roof.
